description: This Java class models the <notify> XML element in the Apache OFBiz service configuration framework. It extracts the type attribute and content of the notify element, providing accessors for external use.

classes.name: Notify
classes.description: A thread-safe class representing the <notify> element in service configuration, encapsulating its type and content.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Notify object by extracting the type attribute and content from the provided XML element, throws ServiceConfigException on invalid input.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content associated with this notify element.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type attribute of this notify element.
